oneLiner: 温度表示冷热程度；摄氏℃与热力学温标 K 满足 K=℃+273.15。
detail: 温度表示冷热程度，它的严格依据是热平衡：两个系统接触后不再有净热量交换，就说它们温度相同，而热平衡的传递性（即第零定律）才让温度计能够读数。热力学温度（开尔文）是国际单位制基本单位，零度为绝对零度。式中 K 为热力学温度（开尔文），℃ 为摄氏温度，两者只差零点位置，1 K 的间隔与 1 ℃ 完全相同；2019 年单位制重新定义之后，开尔文直接由玻尔兹曼常数 k=1.380649×10⁻²³ 焦耳每开尔文固定下来，不再依赖任何具体物质的性质。从微观看，温度是分子热运动剧烈程度的量度，理想气体分子的平均平动动能等于 3kT/2，300 K 时约 6.2×10⁻²¹ 焦耳。摄氏温标 1742 年提出时其实是倒着刻的，0 度标在水的沸点、100 度标在冰点，不久后才被翻转成今天的样式。温度计也不只靠热胀冷缩一种原理：水银与酒精温度计靠液柱体积，铂电阻与热电偶靠电阻和温差电压，红外测温枪靠辐射强度，量程与响应速度各有所长。标定上历史上曾用冰点，后来改用更稳定的水的三相点 0.01 ℃，因为冰点会随气压与溶入的空气浮动。体温计的量程只有 35 到 42 ℃、分度值 0.1 ℃，玻璃泡上方的缩口让水银柱离开人体后不回落，读数前得甩几下才复位；我国已按汞公约的安排自 2026 年起停止生产含汞体温计。热胀冷缩也不是普遍规律：水在 4 ℃ 时密度最大，0 到 4 ℃ 之间反而热缩冷胀，所以冬天湖面结冰而湖底保持约 4 ℃，鱼得以往来越冬；把铜片与铁片铆成双金属片，受热会朝固定一侧弯曲，温控开关与老式温度计用的就是它。常见误区有两个：一是把温度当成内能，温度只反映分子平均动能，一杯 80 ℃ 的水的内能远小于一池 20 ℃ 的水；二是以为温度能降到绝对零度，量子力学并不允许，绝对零度只能无限逼近而不能到达。微观解释见「分子动理论」条，单位口径见「国际单位制」条。
detailEn: Temperature is a measure of hotness, and its rigorous basis is thermal equilibrium: two systems that exchange no net heat when placed in contact are at the same temperature, and the transitivity of that relation - the zeroth law - is exactly what lets a thermometer be read at all. Thermodynamic temperature in kelvin is an SI base unit whose zero is absolute zero. In the formula, K is the thermodynamic temperature in kelvin and ℃ is the Celsius reading: the two differ only in where zero sits, and a step of 1 K is identical to a step of 1 ℃. Since the 2019 restatement of the SI the kelvin is fixed directly through the Boltzmann constant k=1.380649×10⁻²³ joules per kelvin rather than through the properties of any particular substance, and microscopically temperature measures how violently the molecules move - the mean translational kinetic energy of an ideal-gas molecule is 3kT/2, about 6.2×10⁻²¹ joule at 300 K. When Celsius proposed his scale in 1742 it was written backwards, with 0 at the boiling point of water and 100 at its freezing point, and the flip into today's form came only shortly afterwards. Thermometers do not all rely on expansion: mercury and alcohol columns read volume, platinum resistance thermometers and thermocouples read resistance and thermoelectric voltage, and an infrared pyrometer reads radiated power, each with its own span and speed of response. Calibration once used the ice point but moved to the far steadier triple point of water at 0.01 ℃, because the ice point drifts with air pressure and with the air dissolved in the water. A clinical thermometer spans only 35 to 42 ℃ with 0.1 ℃ graduations, and the narrow constriction above its bulb stops the mercury column falling once it leaves the body, so it must be shaken down before reuse; under the mercury convention China has stopped producing mercury thermometers from 2026. Expansion on heating is not universal either: water is densest at 4 ℃ and actually shrinks when heated between 0 and 4 ℃, which is why a lake freezes at the surface while the bottom stays near 4 ℃ and fish survive the winter; bonding copper to iron in a bimetallic strip makes it bend in a fixed direction when warmed, the element inside thermostats and older thermometers. Two mistakes are worth naming: temperature is not internal energy, since it tracks only the mean molecular kinetic energy and a cup of water at 80 ℃ holds far less internal energy than a pond at 20 ℃; and reaching absolute zero is impossible, since quantum mechanics forbids it and one can only approach it. For the microscopic reading see the kinetic theory entry, and for the unit conventions see the SI units entry.

oneLiner: 物质由大量分子组成，分子永不停息做无规则运动，分子间有作用力。
oneLinerEn: Matter is made of molecules in perpetual random motion with intermolecular forces.
detail: 物质由大量分子组成，分子永不停息地做无规则运动，分子之间同时存在引力与斥力，这三条就是分子动理论的全部内容。分子小到什么程度？把 1 摩尔水的体积 18 立方厘米除以阿伏伽德罗常数 6.02×10²³，每个分子平均只分到约 3×10⁻²⁹ 立方米，边长是 0.3 纳米的量级；粗测时可以让一滴已知体积的油酸在水面摊成单分子油膜，用油滴体积除以油膜面积就直接得到分子直径，这是「数量级估算」条所说的把微观量变成可测量的典型做法。扩散是第一条证据：墨滴入水、腌菜入味、把磨平的金块与铅块压紧放上几年，界面处都能测到彼此渗入；气体最快、液体次之、固体最慢，温度越高越快，所以热炒比凉拌更入味。布朗运动是第二条证据：1827 年布朗在显微镜下看花粉在水中的微粒，见到它们不停地抖动折线；微粒比分子大千万倍以上，动的并不是分子本身，而是液体分子从四面八方的撞击不平衡，颗粒越小、温度越高，抖动越剧烈。爱因斯坦 1905 年给出微粒平均平方位移正比于时间的定量关系，佩兰 1908 年用实验把它证实，原子与分子才真正被学界当作实物接受；玻尔兹曼为原子实在论争了半生，1906 年去世，没能等到结论（见「路德维希·玻尔兹曼」条）。分子力随距离变化：在约 10⁻¹⁰ 米的平衡距离上引力与斥力恰好抵消，更近时斥力陡增，稍远时引力为主，超过约十个平衡距离就可以忽略——两块破镜对接后仍然不牢，是因为真正落到平衡距离以内的分子少得可以忽略，而不是分子力失灵。三条常见误区：布朗运动不是分子的运动而是微粒的运动；扩散在 0 ℃ 照样进行，并非只有高温才有；温度越低分子运动越慢但绝不会停止，因为绝对零度不能到达。分子力的宏观表现——拉断一根绳要用力、两块铅压在一起会粘住——与这套图像同口径，温度的微观含义见「温度与温标」条。
detailEn: Kinetic theory says three things: matter is made of an enormous number of molecules, they are in ceaseless random motion, and they exert both attractive and repulsive forces on one another. How small is a molecule? Dividing the volume of one mole of water, 18 cubic centimetres, by Avogadro's number 6.02×10²³ leaves about 3×10⁻²⁹ cubic metre per molecule, a cube roughly 0.3 nanometre on a side; in the crude classroom measurement a known drop of oil acid is allowed to spread into a monolayer on water, and dividing its volume by the film area hands over the molecular diameter directly - the very move the order-of-magnitude estimation entry calls turning a microscopic quantity into something measurable. Diffusion is the first piece of evidence: ink spreading in water, salt working into a pickle, and a flattened gold block pressed against lead for years all show interpenetration at the boundary. It runs fastest in gases, slower in liquids and slowest in solids, and speeds up with temperature, which is why a hot stir-fry seasons better than a cold dressing. Brownian motion is the second: in 1827 Brown watched pollen grains jitter and dart along jagged lines under a microscope in water. The grains are more than ten million times larger than molecules, so what one sees is not molecular motion itself but the imbalance of molecular blows arriving from every side, and the smaller the grain and the higher the temperature, the wilder the jitter. Einstein gave the quantitative law in 1905 - the mean square displacement grows in proportion to time - and Perrin confirmed it experimentally in 1908, which is when atoms and molecules were finally accepted as real rather than as bookkeeping; Boltzmann had argued for their reality most of his life and died in 1906 without seeing the verdict, as the Boltzmann entry notes. The molecular force depends sharply on separation: at about 10⁻¹⁰ metre attraction and repulsion cancel, closer in the repulsion climbs steeply, a little farther out attraction dominates, and beyond some ten equilibrium spacings the force can be ignored. Two broken pieces pressed back together do not rejoin because so few molecules fall inside the equilibrium distance, not because the force has failed. Three misunderstandings are worth clearing up: Brownian motion is the motion of the grain and not of the molecule; diffusion proceeds at 0 ℃ as well, not only at high temperature; and cooling never stops the motion, because absolute zero cannot be reached. The macroscopic signatures - the force needed to snap a rope, two clean lead blocks sticking when pressed - belong to the same picture, and the microscopic meaning of temperature is taken up in the temperature and scales entry.

oneLiner: 物体内所有分子动能与势能的总和。
oneLinerEn: Total molecular kinetic and potential energy of a body.
detail: 内能是物体内所有分子热运动动能与分子势能的总和，只记分子世界的账：一辆停着的烫手汽车内能不为零，机械能却可以为零，把物体的宏观动能与被举高的重力势能算进内来是常见错误（机械能口径见「机械能守恒」条）。内能与温度、体积、物态有关；理想气体因为忽略分子间作用力、没有分子势能，其内能就只取决于温度。改变内能有两条途径：做功与热传递，而且在改变内能这一点上两者完全等效——1 焦耳的功与 1 焦耳的热进入内能账本毫无差别，这正是等效替代的思路在热学里的用法（口径见「等效替代法」条）。历史上这一点曾激烈争论：长期流行的热质说认为热是一种没有质量、能从高温物流向低温流的流体；焦耳从 1843 年起用重物下落带动叶片搅水的实验，测得热功当量约 4.184 焦耳对应 1 卡，把做功多少与升温多少定量挂钩，热质说就此让位。顺带来一个数量级感：1 千克水下落 1000 米，若重力做的功全部变成它自身的内能，也只够让它升温约 2.3 ℃，可见机械能转成内能并不显眼；搓手变暖的摩擦生热、钻木取火、刹车片烫手、流星体进入大气烧蚀，走的都是同一条路。概念上还有一个必须分清的地方：内能是状态量，热量与功是过程量，说物体含有多少热量是错的。高频易错在于同温度不等于同内能：0 ℃ 的冰与 0 ℃ 的水温度相同，内能却不同，因为冰熔化成水要吸收每千克约 3.34×10⁵ 焦耳的熔解热而温度不变，吸收的能量用来破坏晶格、增大分子势能；同理 100 ℃ 的水变成 100 ℃ 的水蒸气还要再吸每千克约 2.26×10⁶ 焦耳。温度的微观含义见「分子动理论」条，功与能的换算见「功与功率」条，把两者合起来记账就是「热力学第一定律」条。
detailEn: Internal energy is the sum of all the random molecular kinetic energy and the molecular potential energy inside a body, and it keeps only the molecular accounts: a parked car with a hot engine has plenty of internal energy while its mechanical energy may be zero, and mixing the body's bulk kinetic energy or its gravitational energy into internal energy is the usual slip, as the conservation of mechanical energy entry draws the line. Internal energy depends on temperature, volume and phase; for an ideal gas, where intermolecular forces and therefore molecular potential energy are ignored, it is a function of temperature only. Two routes change it - doing work and transferring heat - and on this score the two are entirely equivalent, one joule of work and one joule of heat entering the internal-energy ledger without distinction, which is exactly equivalent substitution at work in thermal physics (see the equivalent substitution entry). Historically this was contested: the caloric theory held heat to be a massless fluid flowing from hot bodies to cold, and from 1843 Joule's experiments, in which a falling weight drove paddles through water, measured the mechanical equivalent of heat at about 4.184 joule per calorie, tying the work done to the temperature rise and ending caloric theory. A sense of scale: 1 kilogram of water falling 1000 metres, if all its lost gravitational work became its own internal energy, would warm itself by only about 2.3 ℃, so the conversion of mechanical energy into internal energy is understated rather than dramatic - rubbing hands, drilling fire, overheated brake pads and meteorites ablating in the atmosphere all take this same road. One distinction must be kept: internal energy is a state quantity while heat and work are process quantities, so saying a body contains so much heat is simply wrong. A frequent trap is equal temperature without equal internal energy: ice at 0 ℃ and water at 0 ℃ share a temperature but not an internal energy, because melting absorbs about 3.34×10⁵ joule per kilogram with no temperature change, the energy going into breaking the crystal lattice and raising the molecular potential energy; turning 100 ℃ water into 100 ℃ steam costs a further 2.26×10⁶ joule per kilogram. The microscopic meaning of temperature is in the kinetic theory entry, the work-energy conversion in the work and power entry, and keeping both books together is the first law of thermodynamics entry.

oneLiner: 能量守恒在热学中的表述：ΔU=Q+W（吸热与做功均改变内能）。
oneLinerEn: Energy conservation: ΔU=Q+W (heat and work change internal energy).
detail: 热力学第一定律是能量守恒定律在热力学系统的具体形式。式中 ΔU 为内能变化，Q 为系统吸收的热量，W 为外界对系统做的功。符号口径必须先声明：本站取 W 为外界对系统做的功，因此压缩气体与吸热都让内能增加；不少教材把 W 定义成系统对外做的功，公式随之写成 ΔU=Q−W，两者的物理内容一致，读题时先看约定再动笔算，这是最容易丢分的地方。四条常用推论：绝热过程 Q=0，外界对气体做功则升温，气体自己膨胀则降温，给自行车打气时筒壁发热、喷雾罐喷一会儿罐体变凉、湿润空气沿山坡爬升因绝热膨胀而凝结成云致雨，走的都是这一条；等容过程 W=0，吸热全部变成内能；等温过程对理想气体 ΔU=0，吸收的热量全部用来对外做功；循环过程回到初态，ΔU=0，一个循环净吸的热等于净做的功，热机正是靠这一点吃饭。能量守恒意味着第一类永动机，也就是不消耗能量而能源源不断对外做功的机器，根本造不出来；而光有守恒还不够，方向性的另一半限制见「热力学第二定律」条。混合量热法是常用的定量手段：在保温良好的容器里让热水与冷水混合，放出的热等于吸收的热，可以求末温或比热。把 1 千克 90 ℃ 的水与 1 千克 20 ℃ 的水混合，末温约 55 ℃；但若混进去的是 0 ℃ 的冰，就必须先扣掉熔解热，末温会明显低于只按比热算出的值，凡有相变就不能只用 Q=cmΔt（见「比热容」条与「物态变化」条）。热功当量的测定口径见「内能」条，绝热与等温的过程约束见「气体实验定律」条，能量在各形式之间的总量守恒见「机械能守恒」条。
detailEn: The first law is the conservation of energy written for thermodynamic systems. In the formula, ΔU is the change in internal energy, Q the heat absorbed by the system and W the work done on it by the surroundings. The sign convention has to be declared first: this site takes W as work done on the system, so compressing a gas and heating it both raise the internal energy, while many textbooks define W as work done by the system and write ΔU=Q−W instead; the physics is the same, and reading which convention a problem uses before calculating is where marks are most often lost. Four standard corollaries: in an adiabatic process Q=0, so work done on the gas warms it and expansion cools it - a bicycle pump grows hot in the hand, a spraying can turns cold after a few seconds, and moist air climbing a slope condenses into rain as it expands adiabatically; at constant volume W=0 and all absorbed heat becomes internal energy; in an isothermal process an ideal gas keeps ΔU=0 and converts all its absorbed heat into work done outward; and around a complete cycle the system returns to its starting state so ΔU=0, meaning the net heat taken in equals the net work delivered, which is precisely how a heat engine earns its living. Conservation of energy puts the first kind of perpetual motion machine - one that works forever without any energy input - out of existence, but conservation alone is not enough, and the missing half, the restriction on direction, is the second law of thermodynamics entry. The method of mixtures is the everyday quantitative tool: hot and cold water are combined in a well lagged vessel, heat given up equals heat taken, and one solves for the final temperature or the specific heat. Mixing 1 kilogram of water at 90 ℃ with 1 kilogram at 20 ℃ lands near 55 ℃, but if the addition is ice at 0 ℃ the latent heat of melting has to come off the top first and the final temperature falls well below what the specific-heat formula alone predicts; whenever a phase change is involved Q=cmΔt stops being sufficient, as the specific heat and phase change entries explain. The mechanical equivalent of heat is taken up in the internal energy entry, the adiabatic and isothermal constraints in the gas laws entry, and the accounting of energy across forms in the conservation of mechanical energy entry.

oneLiner: 单位质量升高 1℃ 吸收的热量：Q=cmΔt。
oneLinerEn: Heat to raise 1 kg by 1℃: Q=cmΔt.
detail: 比热容是物质本身的属性，即单位质量的物质温度升高 1 ℃ 所吸收的热量。式中 Q 为吸收或放出的热量，c 为比热容，m 为质量，Δt 为温度变化。c 不随 Q、m、Δt 改变，说比热容与吸热成正比、与质量成反比是概念错误；它还随物态而变，冰的比热约 2.1×10³ 焦耳每千克摄氏度，只有水的一半左右。水的比热容 4.2×10³ 焦耳每千克摄氏度在常见物质里最大的一档，砂石约 0.92×10³、铁约 0.46×10³，同样受热时水的升温只有砂石的十分之一上下，于是有了沿海冬暖夏凉、内陆地区昼夜温差大的差别，也决定了白天风从海面吹向陆地、夜间反过来吹的海陆风（万物地理里“海边白天风为什么从海上吹来”一条用的正是同一机制）。城市比郊区常高 1 到 3 ℃ 的热岛效应，除了人为排热，还因为水泥与沥青热容大、蓄热多，而水面与植被的蒸发散热少（参见万物地理“城市为什么比郊区更热、雨更多”条）。工程上大量用水做冷却剂，看中的正是它比热大、便宜、易得：汽车发动机靠水冷循环把燃烧热带走约三分之一，暖气片、地暖与电站冷凝器同理；散热器要加鳍片、加风扇，是为了增大面积与加快热传递（见「热传递」条）。人靠出汗蒸发散热，当空气潮湿闷热、汗液难以蒸发时体温调节就会失灵，中暑的危险正来自这一点（体温调节口径见「万物生物」的内环境稳态条）。实验室里的比热实验多用混合量热法：保温、搅拌、快速读数、控制变量缺一不可，任何散热漏失都会让测得值偏小（见「控制变量法」条与「误差与有效数字」条）。算例：把 2 千克水从 20 ℃ 烧到 100 ℃ 需要 6.7×10⁵ 焦耳，用 1 千瓦的电水壶约需 11 分钟，而提供同样的热只要烧掉约 15 克汽油，可见燃料热值之高（口径见「热机与效率」条）。水的比热大还带来一个副作用：同样多的热，水温变化小，所以海是巨大的储热库，也是气候的缓冲器。
detailEn: Specific heat is a property of the material itself: the heat needed to raise one kilogram by one degree. In the formula, Q is the heat absorbed or released, c the specific heat, m the mass and Δt the temperature change. c does not vary with Q, m or Δt, so claiming it is proportional to the heat absorbed or inversely proportional to the mass is a conceptual error, and it changes with phase as well - ice sits near 2.1×10³ joule per kilogram per degree, about half that of water. Water's 4.2×10³ is the largest among common substances, against roughly 0.92×10³ for sand and stone and 0.46×10³ for iron, so with the same heat input water warms only about a tenth as much, which is what gives coastlands their mild winters and cool summers and the interior its huge day-to-night swing, and what drives the sea breeze by day and land breeze by night - the same mechanism the geography question bank uses when it asks why seaside wind blows from the sea during the day. The 1 to 3 ℃ urban heat island owes as much to the high heat capacity and storage of concrete and asphalt and to the loss of evaporative cooling from water and vegetation as to the heat people dump (see the geography entry on why cities are hotter than their suburbs and rainier). Engineering uses water as a coolant for exactly this reason: an engine's water loop carries away roughly a third of the heat of combustion, and radiators, underfloor heating and power-station condensers work the same way, while adding fins and a fan to a radiator is about enlarging area and speeding heat transfer, as the heat transfer entry sets out. People shed heat by sweating, and when humid air stops the sweat evaporating, temperature regulation fails, which is where heatstroke comes from (see the biology entry on homeostasis). The laboratory measurement uses the method of mixtures, where insulation, stirring, quick reading and controlled variables are all needed and any heat leak biases the result low, as the control of variables and error and significant figures entries warn. A worked number: raising 2 kilograms of water from 20 ℃ to 100 ℃ costs 6.7×10⁵ joule, about 11 minutes on a 1 kilowatt kettle, and the same heat comes from burning only some 15 grams of gasoline, which shows how dense a fuel's energy is (see the heat engine and efficiency entry). One side effect of water's great heat capacity is worth naming: the sea is an enormous storehouse of heat and therefore a buffer for climate.

oneLiner: 热由高温传向低温，方式有传导、对流、辐射。
oneLinerEn: Heat moves from hot to cold by conduction, convection, radiation.
detail: 热传导、热对流与热辐射这三条路总是同时出现，只是主次随场景而变，而它们的方向都一样：热自发地从高温物体流向低温物体，直到热平衡为止。传导靠分子碰撞与自由电子把能量一层层传下去，没有宏观的物质迁移：金属快，银与铜的导热率约 400 瓦每米开尔文，空气与聚苯乙烯泡沫只有 0.03 左右，差着上万倍，所以冬天赤脚踩瓷砖比踩木地板更冷，并不是瓷砖温度低，而是它把脚底的热抽走得快；被子与羽绒服靠锁住静止空气保温，晒被子恢复蓬松就是把空气层重新撑起来。对流只能发生在流体里，靠宏观流动搬热：受热部分密度变小而上升、较冷的部分补上来，就是自然对流，暖气片装在低处、冰箱里冷空气自上而下、烟顺烟囱而出都属此类；用电扇或水泵强迫流动叫强制对流，海陆风与大气环流是自然对流的大尺度样本。辐射不需要任何介质，是电磁波携带能量，因而也是真空中唯一的方式，太阳的热正是穿过太空的真空抵达地球。辐射强弱随热力学温度的四次方增长，峰值波长随温度升高而变短（口径见「电磁波谱与应用」条），307 开尔文的人体峰值在约 9.4 微米的红外波段，红外热像仪就是靠它成像；黑色粗糙面吸收与发射都强，白亮抛光面两者都弱。保温瓶又称杜瓦瓶，1892 年由杜瓦发明，它一次堵住三条路：真空夹层断掉传导与对流，镀银内壁反射辐射，短颈与塞子减少口部散热，因此既能保冷也能保热，但只能减慢传热而不能阻止。晴朗无风的夜晚地面向外强烈辐射而辐射冷却，气温降到露点以下就结露，再低就直接凝华为霜（万物地理“晴朗无风的夜晚为什么容易起霜”一条与此同一口径）。判断谁主导要看场景：锅柄烫手是传导，烧开水是对流，围着火炉与晒背是辐射。最后记住热量既不是温度也不是内能，它只是传递过程中能量的多少，内能的口径见「内能」条。
detailEn: Thermal conduction, thermal convection and thermal radiation are always present together and only trade places in importance from scene to scene, while all three share one direction: heat runs spontaneously from hot to cold until equilibrium is reached. Conduction passes energy down layer by layer through molecular collisions and free electrons with no bulk transfer of matter: metals are quick, silver and copper conduct at roughly 400 watt per metre kelvin while air and polystyrene foam manage about 0.03, some ten thousand times less, so bare feet find a tiled floor colder than a wooden one not because the tile is at a lower temperature but because it drains heat from the sole faster; quilts and down jackets insulate by trapping still air, and airing them out fluffs the air layers back up. Convection can occur only in fluids and carries heat by bulk motion: warmed fluid becomes less dense and rises while colder fluid takes its place, which is natural convection - radiators sit low, cold air in a refrigerator circulates downward, smoke climbs the chimney - whereas a fan or pump makes it forced convection, and the sea breeze and the general atmospheric circulation are natural convection on a large scale. Radiation needs no medium at all and carries energy as electromagnetic waves, so it is the only route across a vacuum, and the Sun's heat reaches the earth through empty space. Radiated power grows with the fourth power of thermodynamic temperature and the peak wavelength shortens as temperature rises (see the electromagnetic spectrum and applications entry), so a body at 307 K peaks near 9.4 micrometres in the infrared, which is all a thermal camera needs, and black rough faces both absorb and emit strongly while bright polished faces do neither. The vacuum flask, also called the Dewar after its 1892 invention by Dewar, closes all three roads at once: the vacuum gap kills conduction and convection, the silvered walls reflect radiation, and the short neck with a stopper limits losses at the mouth, so it keeps cold things cold as readily as hot things hot, slowing transfer but never stopping it. On a clear windless night the ground radiates away its heat and cools radiatively, dew forms once the air drops to its dew point and frost deposits directly from vapour below that, which is the same account the geography question gives for why clear still nights are frosty. Deciding which route dominates is a matter of scene: a hot pan handle is conduction, boiling water is convection, and sitting by a fire or sunbathing is radiation. One last caution: heat is neither temperature nor internal energy but simply energy in transit, and the internal energy entry draws that line.

oneLiner: 熔化/凝固、汽化/液化、升华/凝华，相变时温度常保持不变。
oneLinerEn: Melting/freezing, vaporization/condensation, sublimation/deposition; temperature stays put during phase change.
detail: 六种变化两两互逆：熔化与凝固、汽化与液化、升华与凝华，前三个吸热、后三个放热。晶体有固定熔点，非晶体如玻璃、松香、沥青与蜡没有，加热时只是逐渐变软变稀，这是教材常作的区分。晶体熔化时吸热而温度不变，因为能量用来破坏晶格、增加分子势能，而温度只记平均动能的账（温度的微观含义见「分子动理论」条）；同理凝固要放热，所以果农在霜夜往苗圃灌水，水结冰释放的熔解热能把苗护住。潜热的数值很大：冰的熔解热约 3.34×10⁵ 焦耳每千克，相当于把同质量的水升温约 80 ℃ 所需的热；水的汽化热约 2.26×10⁶ 焦耳每千克，相当于升温约 538 ℃，这就是 100 ℃ 的水蒸气烫伤远比 100 ℃ 的开水严重的道理，也是发烧时出汗能带走大量热的原因。汽化分两条路：蒸发在任何温度下都进行、只发生在表面、并且有致冷作用，湿衣服晾干、狗伸舌喘气、擦酒精降温靠的都是它，影响它的三个因素是温度、表面积与空气流动；沸腾则要在特定温度下于表面和内部同时发生，气泡升到液面破裂，而且必须继续供热才能维持。气压与沸点的关系是一条正相关：气压升高沸点随之升高，高原油压约 60 千帕时水到 86 ℃ 就沸腾，饭煮不熟才需要高压锅，而密封的高压锅把压强提到约 2 个标准大气压、沸点升到约 120 ℃，饭菜熟得快。液化有两条路，降温和压缩体积，液化石油气在常温下靠压缩成液态装进钢瓶，冬天哈气、冰镇饮料外壁的水珠、洗过热水澡时镜面上的一层雾都是水汽遇冷液化；此处最常考的一个说法是白气不是水蒸气而是悬浮的小水滴，水蒸气本身看不见。露是水汽在草叶上液化的产物，霜是水汽直接凝华，雾是近地面水汽液化成悬浮小滴的天气现象，判断时先看温度是否降到 0 ℃ 以下。升华与凝华的例子：樟脑丸越放越小、冻干食品先把原料冻结再在真空里让冰升华脱水、钨丝蒸发后在灯泡内壁凝华发黑、干冰升华吸热使周围水汽凝华成冰核从而人工降雨。易错有三处：达到熔点还不算熔化，必须继续吸热；标准气压下冰水混合物的温度是 0 ℃ 而不是 4 ℃；有相变时不能再单纯用比热公式算末温（见「比热容」条与「热力学第一定律」条）。海陆风与霜的口径与万物地理同出一源。
detailEn: Melting and freezing, vaporisation and condensation, sublimation and deposition are three inverse pairs, the first of each absorbing heat and the second releasing it. Crystals have a fixed melting point while amorphous solids such as glass, rosin, pitch and wax do not - they merely soften and thin out on heating, which is the standard textbook distinction. A melting crystal takes in heat at constant temperature because the energy goes into dismantling the lattice and raising molecular potential energy, while temperature books average kinetic energy only, as the kinetic theory entry explains; freezing therefore gives heat back, which is why growers flood seedbeds on frosty nights, since the latent heat released by the freezing water shields the seedlings. The latent heats are large: melting ice costs about 3.34×10⁵ joule per kilogram, as much heat as would raise the same mass of water by some 80 ℃, and vaporising water costs 2.26×10⁶ joule per kilogram, equivalent to a 538 ℃ rise, which is why a scald from 100 ℃ steam is far worse than one from 100 ℃ boiling water, and why sweating off a fever removes so much heat. Vaporisation runs on two tracks: evaporation happens at any temperature, only at the surface, and cools the liquid, which is how wet clothes dry, how a dog pants to lose heat and how rubbing alcohol chills the skin, with temperature, surface area and airflow as the three controls; boiling needs its own characteristic temperature, happens at the surface and inside together as bubbles that break at the top, and stops the moment heating stops. The boiling point follows the pressure: at a plateau pressure of some 60 kilopascals water boils already at 86 ℃ and rice refuses to cook through, which is why high ground needs a pressure cooker, and a sealed cooker raising the pressure to about two atmospheres pushes the boiling point near 120 ℃ so food softens quickly. Condensation also has two routes, cooling and compressing the volume - liquefied petroleum gas is simply propane squeezed liquid into a cylinder at ordinary temperature, while breath fogging in winter, beads on a cold drink can and the film on a bathroom mirror are vapour meeting a cold surface. The exam favourite here is that white mist is not water vapour but suspended droplets, since vapour itself is invisible. Dew is vapour liquefied on blades of grass, frost is vapour deposited directly, and fog is droplets suspended near the ground, so the first question is whether the surface fell below 0 ℃. Sublimation and deposition: mothballs shrink away, freeze-dried food is first frozen then placed in vacuum so its ice sublimes straight out, tungsten evaporated from a filament darkens the bulb by depositing on it, and dry ice seeding rain works by subliming, cooling the air until vapour deposits into ice nuclei. Three traps: reaching the melting point is not melting, since heat must keep flowing in; an ice-water mixture sits at 0 ℃ at one atmosphere, not 4 ℃; and once a phase change is in play the final temperature cannot be found from the specific-heat formula alone, as the specific heat and first law entries warn. The accounts of the sea breeze and of frost run together with the geography course.

oneLiner: 将内能转化为机械功的装置；效率受卡诺极限约束。
oneLinerEn: A device turning internal energy into work; efficiency is bounded by Carnot's limit.
detail: 热机把内能转化为机械功，效率 η 等于有用功与吸收热量之比。式中 η 为热机效率，T热 与 T冷 为高温、低温热源的热力学温度（开尔文）；卡诺热机效率 η=1−T冷/T热，只与两热源温度有关，而任何实际热机都达不到这个上限。按 600 K 与 300 K 算上限是 50%，按 800 K 与 300 K 算约 62.5%，可实际柴油机只做到 40% 上下，蒸汽机在 10% 左右徘徊，早期的往复式蒸汽机甚至只有百分之几，可见上限从来不是瓶颈。蒸汽机是外燃机，燃烧在气缸外的锅炉里进行，热量要穿过缸壁与管道，瓦特改良后的机型效率不过百分之几，这是它被取代的原因。内燃机把燃烧搬进气缸，减少了缸壁散热与笨重锅炉，效率大幅提高：四冲程的工作循环是吸气、压缩、做功、排气，曲轴转两转只有一个冲程对外做功，转速 3000 转每分意味着每缸每秒 25 个做功冲程，压缩冲程把机械能转为内能（见「内能」条），做功冲程反过来。汽油机靠火花塞点燃，压缩比约 8 到 11；柴油机没有火花塞，把空气压到柴油自燃，压缩比 14 到 25，效率更高、更省油但更重。燃料的本领用热值衡量：汽油约 4.6×10⁷ 焦耳每千克、柴油约 4.3×10⁷、无烟煤约 3.4×10⁷、氢约 1.43×10⁸，燃烧是化学反应，口径见「万物化学」的燃烧热条。效率为什么上不去？废气带走约三分之一的热、冷却系统带走约三分之一、剩下才轮到摩擦与不完全燃烧，这也是给锅炉与发动机加余热回收的道理。把 η=1−T冷/T热 与「热力学第二定律」条一起读才完整：即使没有摩擦，热机也不能把吸收的热全部变成功，因为必须有冷源接收废热。工程上提高上限的办法是把高温热源做热——涡轮前温度已推到 1400 到 1700 ℃ 并靠叶片气膜冷却撑住，而冷源受环境温度卡住，几乎无从下手。数值锚：效率 30% 的热机每吸入 1 兆焦耳的热，只输出 0.3 兆焦耳的功，余下 0.7 兆焦耳变成废热排入环境，这也是热污染与城市热岛的一部分来源（见「比热容」条）。
detailEn: A heat engine converts internal energy into mechanical work, with efficiency η equal to useful work over heat absorbed. In the formula, η is the efficiency and T_hot and T_cold are the thermodynamic temperatures of the hot and cold reservoirs; a Carnot engine reaches η=1−T_cold/T_hot, which depends on nothing but those two temperatures, and every real engine falls short of it. At 600 K and 300 K the ceiling is 50 percent, at 800 K and 300 K about 62.5 percent, yet a real diesel manages some 40 percent and a steam engine lingers near 10 percent, with early reciprocating engines down in the single digits, so the ideal ceiling is far from the binding constraint. The steam engine is external combustion: burning happens in a boiler outside the cylinder and its heat must cross walls and pipes, and Watt's improved machines never rose far above a few percent, which is exactly why they were displaced. The internal combustion engine moves the burning inside the cylinder, cutting wall losses and the heavy boiler, and efficiency climbs: the four-stroke cycle runs intake, compression, power and exhaust, the crankshaft turns twice for a single power stroke, so 3000 revolutions per minute means each cylinder fires 25 times a second, with the compression stroke turning mechanical energy into internal energy (see the internal energy entry) and the power stroke reversing that. A petrol engine ignites by spark plug at a compression ratio of 8 to 11; a diesel has no plug and compresses air until injected fuel self-ignites, at 14 to 25, giving better economy at the cost of weight. Fuel quality is measured by calorific value: petrol about 4.6×10⁷ joule per kilogram, diesel 4.3×10⁷, smokeless coal 3.4×10⁷ and hydrogen 1.43×10⁸, and since burning is a chemical reaction the chemistry course's heat of combustion entry sets that convention. Why does efficiency stall? The exhaust carries off roughly a third of the heat, the cooling system another third, and only then come friction and incomplete burning, which is what waste-heat recovery tries to reclaim. Read together with the second law of thermodynamics entry the picture becomes complete: even frictionless, an engine cannot turn all its absorbed heat into work, because a cold sink must accept the waste heat. The practical way to lift the ceiling is to make the hot side hotter - turbine inlet temperatures now reach 1400 to 1700 ℃, held up by film-cooled blades - while the cold side is pinned to ambient temperature and offers almost nothing. One worked number: a 30 percent engine takes in 1 megajoule of heat, delivers 0.3 megajoule of work and dumps 0.7 megajoule into the environment, which feeds both thermal pollution and the urban heat island (see the specific heat entry).

oneLiner: 玻意耳 pV=C、查理 V∝T、盖-吕萨克 p∝T，统一为 pV=nRT。
oneLinerEn: Boyle pV=C, Charles V∝T, Gay-Lussac p∝T, unified as pV=nRT.
detail: 理想气体状态方程把压强、体积、温度与物质的量联系起来。式中 p 为压强，V 为体积，n 为物质的量，R 为气体常数，T 为热力学温度；玻意耳的等温律 pV=C、查理的等容律 p∝T 与盖-吕萨克的等压律 V∝T 是它分别在等温、等容与等压下的特例，R 取 8.314 焦耳每摩尔开尔文，1 摩尔气体在标准状况下占 22.4 升。理想气体本身是理想模型（见「理想模型」条）：分子体积与分子间作用力都被忽略，真实气体在压强不高、温度不低时近似符合，在高压低温下会偏离甚至液化。把方程写成 pV=NkT（N 是分子数、k 是玻尔兹曼常数）就露出它的微观身份：压强来自大量分子对器壁的撞击，决定它的是分子数密度与平均动能，而平均动能正比于温度，与「分子动理论」条同一口径；R=N_A·k，式中 N_A 为阿伏伽德罗常数（亦作阿伏加德罗），数值口径见「摩尔气体常量」条与「阿伏伽德罗常数」条。数字例子：300 K 的空气，按方均根速率公式 √(3RT/M) 取 M=0.029 千克每摩尔算得约 508 米每秒，比声速还快，可见声速并不由分子速率单独决定，而取决于碰撞逐级传递扰动的方式——这一点要回到「声速」条去看。应用与易错同样多：气球升空时外部气压降低而体积膨胀；潜水员上浮时肺内气体膨胀，所以绝不可憋气上升；夏天暴晒的车胎里气体温度上升、体积受限，于是压强增大；用注射器封住一段空气推压感到回弹，正是玻意耳定律的手感。最常见的两个错误是把摄氏温度直接代入公式（必须换成热力学温度，见「温度与温标」条），以及以为温度升高压强必然增大——若体积同时膨胀，压强完全可以不变甚至下降，判断前要先看清哪两个量被约束住。与质量守恒联用时的常用形式是 pV/T 不变（n 固定），而画 p-V 图求功是「图象法与函数思想」条的标准用途。
detailEn: The ideal-gas equation links pressure, volume, temperature and amount of substance. In the formula, p is pressure, V volume, n the amount of substance, R the gas constant and T the thermodynamic temperature; Boyle's isothermal law pV=C, Charles's isochoric law p∝T and Gay-Lussac's isobaric law V∝T are its special cases under constant temperature, volume and pressure respectively, with R=8.314 joule per mole kelvin and one mole of gas occupying 22.4 litres at standard conditions. An ideal gas is an idealised model, as the idealized models entry insists: molecular volume and intermolecular forces are both ignored, so real gases follow the equation well at modest pressure and comfortable temperature but drift away, and even liquefy, under high pressure and low temperature. Rewriting it as pV=NkT, with N the number of molecules and k the Boltzmann constant, exposes its microscopic identity - pressure comes from molecules hammering the wall, set by their number density and their mean kinetic energy, and that energy is proportional to temperature, exactly the reading of the kinetic theory entry. Here R=N_A·k, where N_A is Avogadro's number, whose conventions belong to the molar gas constant and Avogadro's number entries. One number: air at 300 K has a root-mean-square speed of about 508 metre per second from √(3RT/M) with M=0.029 kilogram per mole, faster than sound, so the speed of sound cannot be set by molecular speed alone but by how collisions relay a disturbance, which belongs to the speed of sound entry. Applications and mistakes come in equal supply: a rising balloon expands as outside pressure falls; an ascending diver must never hold his breath because the gas in his lungs expands; a tyre left in summer sun sees its pressure climb as temperature rises in a fixed volume; and pushing the plunger of a syringe with the nozzle sealed gives Boyle's law in the hand. The two commonest errors are substituting a Celsius reading straight into the equation - it must become thermodynamic temperature, as the temperature and scales entry demands - and assuming that heating must raise the pressure: if the volume is free to expand the pressure can stay put or even fall, so one must first identify which two quantities are constrained. With the amount of substance fixed the handy form is pV/T unchanged, and reading work off a p-V diagram is the standard use of the graphs and functional thinking entry.

oneLiner: 热量不能自发从低温物体传向高温物体；孤立系统熵不减。
oneLinerEn: Heat does not flow spontaneously from cold to hot; entropy of an isolated system never decreases.
detail: 热力学第二定律有两类表述，而它们彼此等价。克劳修斯表述说热量不能自发地从低温物体传向高温物体，而不引起其他变化；开尔文与普朗克的表述说不可能从单一热源吸热并把它全部变成功，而不产生其他影响。本条的两句话合起来才是它的全部力量：它指出了宏观过程的方向性，也被视为时间箭头的来源。第一类永动机被「热力学第一定律」条以守恒之名禁止，第二类永动机则是从单一热源（比如海洋）吸热全部变功的机器，它不违反守恒，却被本定律判了死刑；即便理想无摩擦的热机，也必须向冷源放废热，效率上限由「热机与效率」条的卡诺公式给出。熵是这套方向性的量度：可逆过程中 ΔS=Q/T，式中 ΔS 为熵变，Q 为吸收的热量，T 为吸热时的热力学温度，孤立系统的熵永不减少。1 千克水从 0 ℃ 加热到 100 ℃，熵增加约 1.3×10³ 焦耳每开尔文（用 ΔS=mc ln(T2/T1) 算），冰熔化成水时熵增约每千克 1.2×10³ 焦耳每开尔文，都是分子排列从有序走向无序的账；玻尔兹曼把熵写成 S=k ln W，式中 W 是对应宏观状态的微观状态数，这公式就刻在他的墓碑上（见「路德维希·玻尔兹曼」条，术语释义见「熵」条）。能量耗散是本定律的日常面孔：能量总量守恒，但可用度在下降——燃料里的化学能烧完之后变成环境里几十开尔文的低温热，虽然一分不少，却再也收不回来做功，所以能量守恒并不等于不必节约能源。常见误解有四个：一是以为冰箱与空调在违反本定律，其实它们靠压缩机消耗外界做功把热从冷处搬到热处，并非自发，而在开着门的厨房里吹空调只会让房间更热；二是把熵增当成宇宙万物都在变得混乱的口号，局部完全可以变得更有序，只要向环境排出更多的熵，生命与雪花都属此类；三是以为热量大的过程熵就增得多，实际上熵变还除以温度，同样的热在低温处造成的熵变更大；四是以为能量耗散等于能量消失。把时间方向说成由本定律给出，是因为守恒定律本身对过去与未来不分优劣，只有熵增给出一条箭头的指向；而宇宙早期的低熵起点是另一个更深的问题，与「大爆炸宇宙论」条和「宇宙微波背景」条相互衔接。
detailEn: The second law comes in two statements that turn out to be equivalent. Clausius says heat cannot of itself pass from a colder body to a hotter one without further change; Kelvin and Planck say no engine can take heat from a single reservoir and convert it all into work without any other effect. Taken together the two statements do the whole work: they fix the direction of macroscopic processes and are read as the source of the arrow of time. The first kind of perpetual motion machine is barred by the first law of thermodynamics entry on the grounds of conservation; the second kind - one drawing heat from a single reservoir such as the sea and turning it wholly into work - breaks no conservation law yet is condemned by this one, and even a frictionless ideal engine must still discharge waste heat to a cold sink, its ceiling given by the Carnot formula in the heat engine and efficiency entry. Entropy measures this directionness: in a reversible process ΔS=Q/T, where ΔS is the entropy change, Q the heat absorbed and T the thermodynamic temperature at which it is taken, and the entropy of an isolated system never decreases. Heating 1 kilogram of water from 0 ℃ to 100 ℃ adds about 1.3×10³ joule per kelvin (from ΔS=mc ln(T2/T1)), and melting ice adds some 1.2×10³ joule per kilogram, both bookkeeping for the passage from ordered to disordered molecular arrangement; Boltzmann wrote it as S=k ln W, where W is the number of microscopic states matching that macroscopic state, and the formula stands on his tombstone (see the Ludwig Boltzmann entry, and the entropy entry for the term). Energy dissipation is the law's everyday face: the total is conserved but the availability decays, since the chemical energy of fuel ends up as low-grade warmth in the environment at a few hundred kelvin which, though not a joule of it is lost, can never be gathered back to do work, so conservation is no licence for wastefulness. Four misunderstandings are worth naming. First, refrigerators and air conditioners do not violate the law: a compressor spends external work to pump heat from cold to hot, so the transfer is not spontaneous, and running an air conditioner with the kitchen door open only heats the room. Second, the increase of entropy is not a slogan that everything is getting messier: a local region can become far more ordered provided it exports more entropy to its surroundings, as a living body and a snowflake both do. Third, a large heat flow does not automatically mean a large entropy change, since the division by temperature matters and the same heat delivered at low temperature produces the bigger increase. Fourth, dissipation is not disappearance. Calling the second law the origin of the arrow of time is exact in this sense: the conservation laws make no distinction between past and future, and only entropy increase points one way, while the low-entropy starting point of the early universe is a deeper question that meets the big bang theory and cosmic microwave background entries.
